citations.claim: check_rules reports yellow lasted 2s on approach 1 (E) vs limit 4 at step 108; inspect shows EW green at 105, yellow at 106-107, all-red at 108
approach E in EW yellow phase at step 106, start of truncated yellow
approach E still yellow at 107 then all-red at 108, confirming only 2 yellow seconds

counterfactual.change: changed actuated true->false only; fixed-time holds full 4s yellow so no violation

explanation: In actuated mode with long-waiting NS demand (N wait 60+s), the controller recalls/cuts the EW phase and truncates EW yellow to 2s instead of the required yellow_seconds=4. EW green at step 105, yellow only at 106-107, all-red at 108, so checker reports yellow lasted 2s.
vision_note: At step 105 the EW approaches are green, then they are yellow only in steps 106 and 107. By step 108 all four approaches are red, so the yellow visibly lasts only two seconds before red.
